--- text
c|a̲t
--- keys
Right
--- expect
ca̲|t
--- note
One ArrowRight moves by grapheme cluster, not by code unit. The middle glyph is
"a" followed by U+0332 (COMBINING LOW LINE), two code units that form a single
extended grapheme cluster under UAX#29 rule GB9 (do not break before an Extend
character). U+0332 has no precomposed form, so the pair is guaranteed to be
stored as two code units.

The caret starts before the "a" (offset 1). CodeMirror's cursorCharRight runs
@marijn/find-cluster-break, which advances over the base AND its combining mark
and stops at offset 3, before "t". The caret must never land at offset 2,
between "a" and its combining mark, which would paint the caret through the
middle of one rendered glyph. Fixtures 19 and 20 assert the same for astral and
regional-indicator clusters; a base-plus-combining-mark cluster is the third
GB rule family and was untested.
